name_en: Baked Egyptian Moussaka with Lean Beef
name_ar: مسقعة مصرية مخبوزة باللحم قليل الدهن
instructions: Roast or bake eggplant instead of deep-frying; cook lean minced beef with onion, garlic, tomato, and spices; layer with the eggplant and bake until bubbling.
Season fish with cumin, coriander, lemon, and garlic; bake or grill until flaky; cook rice with deeply browned onion and spices; serve together.

name_en: Grilled Shrimp with Rice and Baladi Salad
name_ar: جمبري مشوي مع أرز وسلطة بلدي
aliases: ["Grilled prawns with rice", "Egyptian grilled shrimp plate"]
instructions: Marinate shrimp with garlic, lemon, cumin, paprika, and pepper; grill quickly until opaque; serve with rice and tomato-cucumber salad.

name_en: Grilled Calamari with Lemon and Salad
instructions: Score and season calamari with lemon, garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper; grill briefly over high heat; serve with fresh salad.
Simmer chicken with onion, carrot, celery, tomato, stock, and spices; add orzo near the end and cook until tender.
Simmer lean beef cubes with onion, carrot, zucchini, tomato, stock, and spices until the beef and vegetables are tender.

name_en: Areesh Cheese with Tomato, Cucumber and Baladi Bread
name_ar: جبنة قريش بالطماطم والخيار والعيش البلدي
instructions: Season areesh cheese with black pepper, herbs, and a little olive oil; serve with tomato, cucumber, and a measured portion of baladi bread.
Cook onion and peppers with tomato, garlic, cumin, and paprika; make wells in the sauce, add eggs, cover, and cook until set; serve with bread.

name_en: Hummus Bowl with Eggs and Vegetables
instructions: Spread hummus in a bowl; top with boiled eggs, cucumber, tomato, parsley, paprika, and a small amount of olive oil and lemon.

aliases: ["Chicken baba ghanoush bowl", "Grilled chicken with eggplant dip"]
instructions: Char eggplant and blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, and seasonings; grill chicken breast and serve sliced beside the baba ghanoush and vegetables.

name_en: Baked Eggplant with Chickpeas and Tomato
instructions: Roast eggplant until browned; simmer chickpeas with tomato, onion, garlic, cumin, and coriander; combine and bake briefly before serving.
Cook lentils and rice with cumin and browned onions; mix yogurt with cucumber, mint, and lemon; serve the cool salad beside the mujaddara.

name_en: Roasted Cauliflower with Chickpeas and Tahini
instructions: Roast cauliflower and chickpeas with cumin, paprika, and a small amount of oil; drizzle with lemon-tahini sauce and add fresh herbs.
Mix parsley, tomato, mint, bulgur, lemon, and a small amount of olive oil; grill seasoned chicken and serve it sliced over the tabbouleh.

name_en: Chicken Kebab with Bulgur and Salad
aliases: ["Chicken kebab bowl", "Grilled chicken skewers with bulgur"]
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes with lemon, garlic, paprika, and spices; grill on skewers; serve with cooked bulgur and fresh salad.

name_en: Grilled Beef Steak with Potatoes and Vegetables
name_ar: ستيك لحم مشوي مع بطاطس وخضار
instructions: Season lean steak and grill to the desired safe doneness; roast potatoes and mixed vegetables; rest and slice the steak before serving.

aliases: ["Tuna bean salad", "Mediterranean tuna white bean salad"]
instructions: Combine drained tuna and white beans with tomato, cucumber, onion, parsley, lemon, pepper, and a measured amount of olive oil.
Bake potatoes until tender; mix drained tuna with yogurt, lemon, herbs, and pepper; split the potatoes and fill with the tuna mixture.

name_en: Chicken Stuffed Baked Potato with Yogurt
instructions: Bake potatoes until soft; combine cooked chopped chicken with yogurt, herbs, lemon, and pepper; fill the potatoes and top with chopped vegetables.
Brown chicken lightly; simmer with chickpeas, tomato, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, and stock until the chicken is tender.

aliases: ["Chicken lentil curry", "Red lentil curry with chicken"]
instructions: Cook onion, garlic, ginger, and curry spices; add chicken, red lentils, tomato, and stock; simmer until the lentils are soft and chicken is cooked.
Cook onion, garlic, ginger, and curry spices; simmer chicken in a tomato-based sauce until tender; serve with measured basmati rice.
Cook chicken pieces until browned; glaze lightly with soy, ginger, garlic, and a small amount of sweetener; serve over rice with steamed vegetables.

name_en: Beef Stir-Fry with Vegetables and Rice
name_ar: لحم مقلي سريعاً مع الخضار والأرز
aliases: ["Beef vegetable stir fry", "Beef stir fry rice"]
instructions: Quickly sear thin beef strips; stir-fry peppers, broccoli, and carrots; add a light soy-garlic sauce and serve with rice.

aliases: ["Healthy chicken fried rice", "Chicken vegetable fried rice"]
instructions: Stir-fry cooked rice with chicken, egg, peas, carrots, spring onion, garlic, and a small amount of oil and soy sauce over high heat.
Scramble eggs in a hot pan; add cooked rice, peas, carrots, spring onion, garlic, and a measured amount of oil and soy sauce; toss until hot.
Simmer chicken with onion, carrot, celery, garlic, and stock; shred the chicken; add noodles and cook until tender.
Bake or pan-sear salmon; serve over rice with cucumber, carrot, spring onion, and a light soy-lemon dressing.
Cook pasta until al dente; saute shrimp briefly with garlic; simmer tomato sauce with herbs; combine with pasta and shrimp.
Cook pasta; grill or saute chicken and vegetables; toss with a measured amount of pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Grill seasoned chicken; combine tomato, cucumber, onion, olives, lettuce, and a moderate amount of feta; dress with lemon and olive oil.
Grill halloumi slices until browned; toss lettuce, tomato, cucumber, peppers, and herbs with lemon; place the halloumi on top.

name_en: Peanut Butter Banana Toast with Milk
name_ar: توست بزبدة الفول السوداني والموز مع الحليب
instructions: Toast bread; spread with measured peanut butter; top with banana slices and cinnamon; serve with milk.

name_en: Overnight Oats with Yogurt and Berries
instructions: Mix oats with yogurt, milk, chia seeds, and cinnamon; refrigerate overnight; top with berries or other fruit before serving.

name_en: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki and Pita
name_ar: سوفلاكي دجاج مع تزاتزيكي وخبز بيتا
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon, garlic, oregano, and yogurt; grill on skewers; serve with pita, vegetables, and yogurt-cucumber tzatziki.
Saute Egyptian sausage with onion, peppers, tomato, garlic, and spices; stuff into baladi or fino bread and serve hot.
Marinate thin beef with vinegar, garlic, spices, and onion; sear over high heat; wrap in bread with tahini, parsley, tomato, onion, and pickles.
Coat thin chicken cutlets in seasoned flour, egg, and breadcrumbs; fry until crisp and cooked through; serve in bread with lettuce and sauce.

name_en: Chicken Pane with Red Sauce Pasta
aliases: ["Chicken paneh and pasta", "Breaded chicken with tomato pasta"]
instructions: Bread and fry chicken cutlets until crisp; cook pasta and toss with tomato-garlic sauce; serve the chicken beside the pasta.

aliases: ["Egyptian fried fish and rice", "Fried fish sayadeya"]
instructions: Season fish, coat lightly in seasoned flour, and fry until crisp and cooked through; serve with onion-spiced sayadeya rice.
Season shrimp, coat in flour or crumbs, and fry until crisp; fill bread with shrimp, salad, pickles, and a creamy or tahini-based sauce.

aliases: ["Mixed fried seafood", "Fried shrimp calamari fish platter"]
instructions: Season assorted fish, shrimp, and calamari; coat in seasoned flour or crumbs; fry in batches until crisp; serve with lemon and dipping sauce.

aliases: ["Meat goulash Egyptian", "Phyllo pastry with minced beef"]
instructions: Layer phyllo sheets with butter or ghee; spread seasoned cooked minced beef and onion between layers; finish with phyllo and bake until crisp and golden.
Cook rice slowly in milk with sugar and vanilla until creamy; portion into bowls, chill or serve warm, and garnish as desired.

aliases: ["Luqmat al qadi", "Lokmet el qadi", "Sweet fried dough balls"]
instructions: Prepare a soft yeast batter; let it rise; drop small portions into hot oil and fry until golden; coat with sugar, syrup, or powdered sugar.
Cook thin crepes from flour, milk, egg, and a little butter; spread with chocolate-hazelnut spread, fold, and serve warm.
Stretch pizza dough; spread with barbecue sauce; top with cooked chicken, mozzarella, and onion; bake at high heat until browned.
Stretch pizza dough; add a light tomato or white base and a blend of four cheeses; bake at high heat until the crust and cheese are browned.
Prepare a minced-beef tomato sauce and bechamel or ricotta layer; alternate with lasagna sheets and cheese; bake until tender and browned.
Cook spaghetti until al dente; cook beef bacon or another suitable cured meat; combine hot pasta with egg, hard cheese, black pepper, and the cooked meat off the direct heat.
